prioritisation_rule: External blockers do not pause internal foundation work. Work first on CRITICAL/HIGH tracks whose next step is not blocked, while preserving scientific, privacy, security and SEO release gates.

audit.rule: Every material foundation change must remain visible in the machine-readable audit rather than relying on memory or prose status alone. A green audit proves repository consistency, not external provider activation.

reconciliation_evidence.rule: Source implementation and recorded release evidence are distinct from independently rerun production certification. No production state is promoted by this reconciliation.
reconciliation_evidence.implemented: Bertina PHP/MySQL email-only identity/session API, SMTP transport, book-only order capture, and receipt/payment contracts.
reconciliation_evidence.pending: Trusted TLS, public auth/email delivery, live payment, Golden Talent persistence, account records/documents/appointments, admin operations, live AI and consented analytics.
reconciliation_evidence.deployment_evidence: Deployment SHA is recorded in the user-supplied audit report; this reconciliation performs no deployment or production recertification.
